title: Southern California Closures and Construction
h1: Southern California closures: what this site can actually support
description: The closure tracker for Magic Mountain, Knott's, Legoland California and SeaWorld San Diego — only what we can support, honestly framed.
intro: This tracker lists only closures this site can support with confidence. Where nothing qualifies, it says so and stays empty — an honest empty tracker beats a confidently wrong one, and every park here has a current attraction list on its own site that outranks any third-party summary.
Items land here when a closure is confirmed and load-bearing for planning; they leave when the ride reopens or is removed. The verification month on each item says when it was last checked.

items.name: Montezooma's Revenge
items.reopening: as part of the Fiesta Village redevelopment
items.note: The 1978 flywheel-loop shuttle closed amid Fiesta Village's reimagining, and its return timeline has extended repeatedly. The park has indicated the ride is expected back; treat that as intention rather than schedule, and check the park's attraction list before promising anyone a ride.

freshness.sourceNote: Structure and policy of the tracker; the items carry their own verification months.
